entries.title: Arena Direct — Hobbit Collector Booster boxes
entries.note: Bo1 Hobbit Sealed. Prizes: gems, packs, and physical Collector Booster boxes at 7 wins (while supplies last). Last day — Aug 23.

entries.title: Bo1 Qualifier Play-In (Timeless)
entries.note: Single-day Best-of-One Timeless Qualifier Play-In. Feeds the Aug 29–30 Qualifier Weekend.

entries.title: Contender Draft (Hobbit)
entries.note: Premier Draft structure with competitive-event prizing. 6 wins: 4,200 gems + 10 packs + 4 mythic packs; 7 wins: 7,200 gems + 12 packs. Ends Sep 29 at 11am PT.

entries.title: Flashback Draft — Tales of Middle-earth
entries.note: Flashback Premier Draft: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth. (Also: Hobbit + LTR mixed Sealed runs Aug 28–Sep 3.)

entries.title: Bo3 Qualifier Play-In (Timeless)
entries.note: Best-of-Three Timeless Qualifier Play-In — last chance to earn a token for the Qualifier Weekend.

entries.title: Arena Direct — Hobbit Play Booster boxes
entries.note: Arena Direct (Bo1). Physical Play Booster boxes for top finishers, while supplies last.

entries.title: Qualifier Weekend (Timeless)
entries.note: Two-day Arena Championship Qualifier Weekend, Timeless (Bo3). Requires a Qualifier Token. Each day has a 2-hour entry window — check in-client for exact times.

entries.title: Mixed-Up Premier Draft
entries.note: 8-player draft with special packs that can contain any collectible card on Arena.

entries.title: Arena Powered Cube
entries.note: Arena Powered Cube returns for three weeks, with new-to-Arena cards and new cards in the Cube Prize Pack rewards. Events typically open 8am PT on the start date and close to entries 8am PT on the end…

entries.title: Hobbit Limited Open ($2k top prize)
entries.note: New competitive draft tournament — two draft events, re-enterable over the weekend, up to $2,000 USD. Not an Arena Limited Championship Qualifier.

entries.title: Bo1 Qualifier Play-In (Hobbit Sealed)
entries.note: Best-of-One Qualifier Play-In. September format: The Hobbit Sealed. Feeds the Sep 19–20 Qualifier Weekend.

entries.title: Arena Direct — Aetherdrift Play Booster boxes
entries.note: Limited-time Arena Direct featuring Aetherdrift Play Booster boxes.

entries.title: Bo3 Qualifier Play-In (Hobbit Sealed)
entries.note: Best-of-Three Qualifier Play-In, The Hobbit Sealed — last chance for a token before the Qualifier Weekend.

entries.title: Qualifier Weekend (Hobbit Sealed)
entries.note: Two-day Arena Championship Qualifier Weekend, The Hobbit Sealed (Bo3). Requires a Qualifier Token. Each day has a 2-hour entry window — check in-client for exact times.

entries.title: Flashback Draft — Outlaws of Thunder Junction
entries.note: Flashback Premier Draft: Outlaws of Thunder Junction.

entries.title: Arena Direct — March of the Machine Set Booster boxes
entries.note: Limited-time Arena Direct featuring March of the Machine Set Booster boxes.
